newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Trans Tasman sells 10 mln AGP shares on mkt.
newsitem.headline: Trans Tasman sells 10 mln AGP shares on mkt.

text.p: New Zealand property investment company Trans Tasman Properties Ltd (TTP) said on Tuesday it had sold a block of 10 million shares in its former subsidiary Australian Growth Properties Ltd (AGP).

As a result of the move, which it said was intended to increase liquidity in AGP in the aftermath of its May 21 listing on the Australian Stock Exchange, TTP said its stake in AGP had fallen to 43.44 percent from 46.72 percent.
In a statement TTP said it remained satisfied that it would continue to satisfy New Zealand Stock Exchange listing rules at this reduced level of holding.
The shares were sold at A$1.00 each to an Australian institution.
One motive for the sale was to help achieve turnover targets "that will allow AGP shares to be included in the ASX market index", TTP added.
